items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Harold Draub and a friend of mine from Baltimore and myself went into Ryan's to see Bechet

ctx.x: I couldn't remember if he was up on 3rd Avenue or someplace. Another friend of ours lived up that way. I forgot.
Harold, I think, or somebody lived up there.
No, another fellow. I can't remember his name. Anyway, go ahead.
